## Security Review Summary

I scanned all 10 relevant files in the repository (source, config, dependency metadata). The dependency `bcrypt@5.1.1` is fine, and `hash.js`, `health.js`, and `config-safe.js` are correct/decoys. | 2 | sensitive-data-exposure | HIGH | `src/auth/login.js`, `src/logging/logger.js`, `src/logging/redact.js` | Login flow logs the user's **plaintext password and auth token** verbatim to stdout. Both findings include concrete data-flow evidence and remediations addressing the actual trust boundary (rotate/externalize the secret; enforce redaction at the logging boundary). `source_modified: false` — no audited source files were changed.
